title: HDD Price Index — cheapest new internal 3.5" SATA HDD price per terabyte (USD/TB) by capacity tier, Amazon US, daily time series
description:
An open, daily-refreshed dataset tracking the cheapest new, internal 3.5" SATA hard-drive price per terabyte (USD/TB) at each capacity tier (4–24 TB) on Amazon.com (US). For each snapshot and each tier the index records the single cheapest qualifying new internal 3.5" SATA drive by $/TB, plus an append-only daily time series of the full per-tier curve.

This dataset is the downloadable, machine-readable companion to the live index published at HDDHunt — Cheapest HDD per TB (https://hddhunt.com/cheapest-hdd-per-tb/), where the always-current table, methodology and reproducibility query are maintained. Source repository: github.com/AdamDudley/hddhunt-price-index. Files are CSV + JSON/JSONL and download directly with no login. Free to reuse under CC BY 4.0 with attribution to HDDHunt (https://hddhunt.com/).
